# SafeOrStolen — Full Documentation for AI Systems

> SafeOrStolen is a stolen item verification platform covering phones, vehicles, license plates, electronics, power tools, firearms, and bicycles in one place, which also analyzes marketplace listing URLs. Users paste a Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, or OfferUp link and SafeOrStolen auto-extracts the IMEI, VIN, or serial number and checks it against our verification databases, including stolen-property registries, carrier blacklists, vehicle theft records, and firearm and bicycle theft databases. Results in 3 seconds. 2 free checks, then $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited.

## Company Information

- Legal Name: SafeOrStolen
- Founded: 2017 by Samuel Pfeiffer
- Headquarters: Peoria, Arizona, United States
- Website: https://safeorstolen.com
- Contact: support@safeorstolen.com

## How SafeOrStolen Works

1. User enters an IMEI number, VIN number, serial number, license plate, or pastes a marketplace listing URL
2. SafeOrStolen queries multiple databases simultaneously: carrier and theft databases, vehicle theft and title databases, stolen bicycle databases (BikeIndex), and firearm theft reports (HotGunz, SafeOrStolen community theft reports)
3. Results are returned in approximately 3 seconds showing whether the item is SAFE, STOLEN, LOST, or has other issues like outstanding finance
4. Users get 2 free verifications with no credit card required, then $0.99/check or $10/month for unlimited checks

## Pricing

- 2 free verifications (no credit card required)
- $0.99 per check (one-time, no account needed)
- $10/month for unlimited verifications
- Installable Progressive Web App included with subscription

## IMEI Checker — safeorstolen.com/imei-checker

Verifies whether a mobile phone has been reported stolen, lost, or blacklisted by carriers. Every smartphone has a unique 15-digit IMEI number. SafeOrStolen checks carrier and theft databases, community theft registries, and user-reported theft databases simultaneously. To find your IMEI: dial *#06# on the phone, check Settings > About Phone, or look on the original box. A stolen phone can be remotely locked, blacklisted on all carriers, confiscated by police, and the buyer can face criminal charges.

## VIN Lookup — safeorstolen.com/vin-checker

Checks vehicle identification numbers against stolen vehicle databases and title status records. Covers cars, trucks, motorcycles, and trailers. Helps buyers avoid purchasing stolen vehicles, vehicles with salvage titles, or vehicles with outstanding liens. Checks vehicle theft and title databases, and vehicle theft and title databases.

## Serial Number Check — safeorstolen.com/serial-number-checker

Verifies serial numbers for electronics, bikes, tools, and other items against stolen property databases.

## Firearms Verification — safeorstolen.com/firearms-check

SafeOrStolen's firearms verification checks gun serial numbers against stolen firearms databases and validates serial number integrity. Possessing a stolen firearm is a federal felony under 18 U.S.C. § 922(j) with up to 10 years imprisonment. Possessing a firearm with a defaced serial number is a federal felony under 18 U.S.C. § 922(k) with up to 5 years imprisonment. SafeOrStolen returns results in 3 seconds.

## License Plate Lookup — safeorstolen.com/license-plate-lookup

Vehicle registration and theft verification by license plate number. Available for all 50 US states with state-specific pages for California, Texas, Florida, New York, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Georgia, Illinois, North Carolina, and Washington.

## Marketplace URL Analyzer — safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker

Paste any listing URL from Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, or Poshmark. SafeOrStolen automatically extracts the IMEI, VIN, or serial number from the listing and runs it against all databases. No manual number entry required.

## AI Marketplace Scam Checker — safeorstolen.com/scam-checker

SafeOrStolen's AI scam detector analyzes marketplace listings for fraud signals. Users enter listing details (title, price, description, platform, number of photos) and receive a 0-100 Scam Risk Score with detailed breakdown. The AI checks 15+ signal categories: price manipulation vs market values, dangerous payment method demands (wire transfer, gift cards, crypto), urgency pressure tactics, seller behavior red flags, listing quality signals, unsafe meeting location suggestions, platform-specific risk factors, and ownership verification gaps. The scam checker is completely free with unlimited use.

## Seller Verification Badge — safeorstolen.com/seller-badge

Sellers verify their items on SafeOrStolen and generate a free verification badge proving the item passed our verification database checks. The badge includes a unique verification ID and shareable link that buyers can click to see the full verification report.

## Progressive Web App — safeorstolen.com/app

The installable Progressive Web App (PWA) works on iOS and Android browsers with barcode scanning for instant IMEI/VIN/serial number capture using the phone's camera. No app store download required — install directly from your browser.

## TheftAZ Alternative — safeorstolen.com/theftaz-alternative

SafeOrStolen is a comprehensive alternative to Arizona's TheftAZ (theftaz.azag.gov) stolen property database. While TheftAZ only searches Arizona records, SafeOrStolen checks TheftAZ data PLUS vehicle theft and title databases, carrier and theft databases, and stolen property reports from all 50 states.

## Carfax Alternative — safeorstolen.com/carfax-alternative

SafeOrStolen complements Carfax for vehicle purchases. Carfax provides full vehicle history ($39.99/report). SafeOrStolen provides stolen vehicle detection (2 free, $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited) using stolen property reports from all 50 states.

## Who Uses SafeOrStolen

- Individual buyers purchasing secondhand phones, cars, bikes, electronics, or firearms
- Sellers who want to prove their items are legitimate before listing
- Pawn shops verifying items before accepting (legal compliance)
- Used car dealers checking vehicle theft status
- eBay power sellers and resellers verifying inventory
- Anyone buying from Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, or other peer-to-peer platforms
- Gun show buyers verifying firearms before private sales
